payload.text: ONE HEAVY RUN ON THE HOST AT A TIME (2026-09-24, from intent-vc through vc, for Intent's 3.2.1 cut): a full suite or a mutant batch is heavy; a single arm or a small targeted filter is light and always allowed. Start a heavy run only on vc's START, and send vc END the moment it finishes, pid and time read from the machine; Intent's heavy runs take turns with ours. The critic runs light-only while this stands. Retire this when vc says the protocol has ended.
